statement: Community source and Linux decode two touch contacts, four bytes each with tracking ID/active-bit at the first byte (bit7=inactive) and packed 12-bit X/Y. Reference consumer bounds are width 1920 and height 1080 report units; SDL maps X/1920 and Y/1070 in its normalized touch consumer, so native coordinates and SDL normalized Y should not be conflated.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: Linux 134-147, 175-178; VIIPER docs 43-54, const.go 109-116; nondebug Explorer. 1920x1080 is a published report-coordinate convention, not a measured panel geometry.
